div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1418px; height: 1px; padding-top: 997px; margin-left: 22px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #424242;
display: inline-block; font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial; color: light-dark(#424242, #b4b4b4); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Solid: user/application traffic. Dashed: trust metadata or workload authorization. UAMI = user-assigned managed identity.
Signed-in tenant users share scenarios; ownership authorization is not implemented. Use synthetic data only.
Microsoft SSO cookie and MSAL cache are separate; browser privacy, expiry, consent and Conditional Access can require sign-in.
API, web and refresh also have registry-scoped AcrPull; the browser identity does not. CI OIDC is a separate deployment principal.

API, web and refresh also have registry-scoped AcrPull; the browser identity does not. CI OIDC is a separate deployment principal.
